name: Regent Phu Quoc
insider_take: This beachfront sanctuary on Vietnam's largest island combines untouched tropical beauty with sophisticated luxury, where pristine white sands meet crystal-clear waters in one of Southeast Asia's most coveted destinations.
whats_special: Regent Phu Quoc sits on the stunning Long Beach with direct access to some of Vietnam's most pristine coastline. The resort features overwater villas - a rarity in Vietnam - and boasts the island's largest infinity pool. Phu Quoc itself is famous for producing Vietnam's finest fish sauce and black pepper, while the surrounding waters are home to vibrant coral reefs perfect for snorkeling.
pro_tip: Visit during dry season (November-March) for the best weather, and don't miss the spectacular sunsets from the resort's western-facing beach - Phu Quoc is one of the few places in Vietnam where you can watch the sun set over the ocean.
dont_miss: Take the world's longest non-stop three-rope cable car to Hon Thom Island, explore the vibrant Dinh Cau Night Market for fresh seafood and local delicacies, and visit a traditional fish sauce factory to learn about the island's most famous export. The nearby Sao Beach, consistently ranked among Asia's most beautiful beaches, is just a short drive away.
pros: Stunning beachfront location on pristine Long Beach
Luxurious villas with private pools and ocean views
Exceptional dining experiences with multiple restaurants
cons: Remote island location requires flight connections
